title: Typed CSV Data Source
description: A data section defines named CSV data sources with typed columns. The CSV header row declares columns as 'columnName:TYPE'. Supported types: STRING, INTEGER, BOOLEAN, DECIMAL. Rows are parsed and type-validated at load time. Data source rows can be used as forEach iteration values and accessed via ${each.<source>.<field>} syntax.

name.description: Unique name for this data source.

csv.description: Inline CSV content. First row is the header with columnName:TYPE format.
